ue},{"paragraph":58,"text":"系统","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"Orc","mentions":[{"paragraph":18,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":19,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":20,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"Human","mentions":[{"paragraph":18,"text":"人类","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":20,"text":"人类","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"Rongcheng","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":83,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"OrcAidAssociation","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"兽人互助协会","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"MedicalCollege","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"医学院","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"OrcFlu","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"兽人流感","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"FulminantMyocarditis","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"暴发性心肌炎","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"Book","mentions":[{"paragraph":2,"text":"本书","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"Characters","mentions":[{"paragraph":2,"text":"角色","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"GodStone","mentions":[{"paragraph":84,"text":"神典石","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d1","from":2,"to":2,"text":"本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["Book","Characters"]},{"id":"d2","from":18,"to":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人名叫苏天晴；这个世界与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但人类与兽人共存。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["OriginalOwner","Human","Orc","Body"]},{"id":"d3","from":19,"to":19,"text":"这里的兽人指猫娘狐娘，不是从地里长出来的大菌子绿皮。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["Orc"]},{"id":"d4","from":20,"to":20,"text":"兽人数量远不及人类；原主苏天晴自幼孤独长大、社恐孤僻，靠兽人互助协会资助考上蓉城最好的医学院，却在临近开学时感染兽人流感，熬夜时突发暴发性心肌炎。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["Orc","Human","OriginalOwner","OrcAidAssociation","MedicalCollege","Rongcheng","OrcFlu","FulminantMyocarditis"]},{"id":"d5","from":21,"to":21,"text":"原主的死法和自己一模一样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"d6","from":8,"to":9,"text":"抛开听起来离谱的反派魔法少女身份不谈，这副身体的模样绝妙，每个细节都满足自己曾经的幻想，让人想细细品尝。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl","Body","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d7","from":12,"to":14,"text":"美妙；自己太可爱了，无论面庞还是身材都与曾经想象的完美匹配；萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d8","from":15,"to":15,"text":"嘿嘿嘿，可爱的小狐狸。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d9","from":26,"to":26,"text":"“……喂？小破书你在吗？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuShu"]},{"id":"d10","from":29,"to":29,"text":"该不会所谓的反派魔法少女根本就不存在吧？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d11","from":35,"to":35,"text":"“好疼！……鼻血！鼻血冒出来了啊啊啊啊！”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d12","from":38,"to":38,"text":"【守护之星激活】","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MysteriousVoice","about":["GuardianStar"]},{"id":"d13","from":39,"to":39,"text":"【秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务】","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MysteriousVoice","about":["GuShu","DailyTask"]},{"id":"d14","from":40,"to":40,"text":"每日任务？守护之星？好家伙你来真的。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask","GuardianStar","MysteriousVoice"]},{"id":"d15","from":42,"to":42,"text":"这枚金色十字星材质不明、做工精致、手感扎实，不像塑料玩具，应该就是魔法少女们必备的变身道具。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar","MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d16","from":43,"to":43,"text":"可这所谓的每日任务……要怎么查看呢？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask"]},{"id":"d17","from":44,"to":44,"text":"像前世网络小说那样心里默念“系统！”，还是有什么特别的解锁密码？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["System"]},{"id":"d18","from":46,"to":46,"text":"比起那个莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对这枚所谓的“守护之星”更感兴趣。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuShu","GuardianStar","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d19","from":47,"to":47,"text":"魔法少女变身！穿着华丽洋装在城市间穿梭飞行与怪人战斗！这具身体的原主人也曾经梦想过这种场面！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MagicalGirl","OriginalOwner","Body"]},{"id":"d20","from":48,"to":48,"text":"要试试看吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d21","from":49,"to":57,"text":"“变……变身！”“魔法少女变身！”“henshin！”“光啊！”“盖亚！！”","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar","MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d22","from":52,"to":52,"text":"嗯？不对吗？变身不是这么喊的？还是说要加点什么前缀？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d23","from":58,"to":58,"text":"这秘典都不给新手指引，别人拿到系统多少有新手任务，至少教我怎么变身。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuShu","System","DailyTask"]},{"id":"d24","from":59,"to":59,"text":"破玩意！没意思！","channel":"thought","mode":"denial","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar","GuShu"]},{"id":"d25","from":61,"to":61,"text":"也没见这上面有写字呀，到底要怎么才能变身呢。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar"]},{"id":"d26","from":66,"to":66,"text":"【初次变身，已完成】","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MysteriousVoice","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar"]},{"id":"d27","from":67,"to":67,"text":"“什、什么东西！？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"d28","from":68,"to":68,"text":"原来是触摸屏的吗！我还以为是声控呢！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar"]},{"id":"d29","from":70,"to":72,"text":"有那么一瞬间，苏天晴想抱着自己狂舔；除了可爱，依然是可爱。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d30","from":74,"to":74,"text":"如果说自己对反派魔法少女这个强行安排的身份还有些残存不满，那看到变身后的模样时，最后的抵触也荡然无存了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d31","from":75,"to":75,"text":"不就是反派魔法少女吗！我这就当给你看！","channel":"thought","mode":"promise","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d32","from":77,"to":77,"text":"那么接下来，该看看所谓的每日任务是怎么回事了。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask"]},{"id":"d33","from":80,"to":84,"text":"古书第一页显示：【苏天晴】【魔法少女（反派）】【每日任务1：找茬魔法少女】【正牌魔法少女在蓉城风生水起已经够久了，给她一点颜色瞧瞧】【奖励：100神典石】","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"GuShu","about":["SuTianqing","VillainMagicalGirl","DailyTask","RealMagicalGirl","Rongcheng","GodStone"]},{"id":"d34","from":85,"to":85,"text":"找茬正牌魔法少女？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["RealMagicalGirl","DailyTask"]},{"id":"d35","from":87,"to":87,"text":"这看似简单的日常任务……好像还真不好做呢……","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b1","from":1,"to":1,"gist":"章节标题：反派的日常就是找茬。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b2","from":2,"to":2,"gist":"作者声明本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在未成年人。","mode":"paratext","about":["Book","Characters"]},{"id":"b3","from":3,"to":3,"gist":"分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b4","from":4,"to":5,"gist":"刷牙漱口的声音与吐出牙膏泡沫。","mode":"narrative","about":[]},{"id":"b5","from":6,"to":7,"gist":"苏天晴洗漱后照镜，看到金毛狐狐般的精致可爱外貌、柔顺毛发与摄人心魄的眼眸。","mode":"description","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"b6","from":8,"to":9,"gist":"苏天晴认为抛开反派魔法少女身份不谈，这副身体绝妙，每个细节都满足自己曾经的幻想。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","VillainMagicalGirl","Body"]},{"id":"b7","from":10,"to":16,"gist":"苏天晴舔镜中自己，陶醉于可爱，认为萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"b8","from":17,"to":21,"gist":"苏天晴收敛发癫状态，审视原主残留记忆：原主也叫苏天晴，世界人类与兽人共存；原主孤独长大，靠兽人互助协会资助考上蓉城医学院，因兽人流感熬夜突发暴发性心肌炎而死，与自己的死法一样。","mode":"exposition","about":["SuTianqing","OriginalOwner","Orc","Human","Body","OrcAidAssociation","MedicalCollege","Rongcheng","OrcFlu","FulminantMyocarditis"]},{"id":"b9","from":22,"to":24,"gist":"想到死法，苏天晴感到胸口幻痛并揉胸，随后停顿。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"b10","from":25,"to":30,"gist":"苏天晴走到客厅躺上沙发，拿起古书呼唤小破书却无回应，怀疑反派魔法少女不存在，翻开扉页。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GuShu","VillainMagicalGirl"]},{"id":"b11","from":31,"to":36,"gist":"金色十字星从书中掉出砸脸，苏天晴流鼻血，鼻血被十字星吸收消失。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GuShu","GuardianStar"]},{"id":"b12","from":37,"to":39,"gist":"陌生声音在脑中响起，宣告守护之星激活、秘典序章完成并开启每日任务。","mode":"exposition","about":["MysteriousVoice","GuardianStar","GuShu","DailyTask"]},{"id":"b13","from":40,"to":42,"gist":"苏天晴惊讶于每日任务与守护之星，拿回发光的十字星，推测它是魔法少女的变身道具。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","DailyTask","GuardianStar","MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"b14","from":43,"to":45,"gist":"苏天晴思考如何查看每日任务，猜测像网络小说那样默念系统或需要解锁密码。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","DailyTask","System"]},{"id":"b15","from":46,"to":49,"gist":"苏天晴对守护之星更感兴趣，幻想魔法少女变身，回忆原主也梦想过，试探着捏星喊出变身。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar","GuShu","MagicalGirl","OriginalOwner","Body"]},{"id":"b16","from":50,"to":57,"gist":"苏天晴反复喊出各种变身词，十字星仍无反应。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar","MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"b17","from":58,"to":59,"gist":"苏天晴抱怨秘典没有新手指引，觉得破玩意没意思。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","GuShu","System","DailyTask"]},{"id":"b18","from":60,"to":63,"gist":"苏天晴瘫在沙发上端详十字星，发现中间凹陷，试探用拇指按住。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar"]},{"id":"b19","from":64,"to":68,"gist":"光芒笼罩客厅，初次变身完成，陌生声音响起，苏天晴惊叫并意识到是触摸屏启动。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar","MysteriousVoice"]},{"id":"b20","from":69,"to":76,"gist":"苏天晴走到落地镜前看变身后的金色短款洋装、白袜、十字星与大尾巴，陶醉可爱，接受反派魔法少女身份并决心当下去。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","GuardianStar","VillainMagicalGirl"]},{"id":"b21","from":77,"to":77,"gist":"苏天晴决定接下来查看每日任务。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","DailyTask"]},{"id":"b22","from":78,"to":84,"gist":"苏天晴维持变身翻开黑色古书，第一页显示身份【苏天晴】【魔法少女（反派）】与每日任务1找茬正牌魔法少女，还有奖励100神典石。","mode":"exposition","about":["SuTianqing","GuShu","VillainMagicalGirl","DailyTask","RealMagicalGirl","Rongcheng","GodStone"]},{"id":"b23","from":85,"to":87,"gist":"苏天晴看到找茬正牌魔法少女的任务后一怔，觉得这日常任务不好做。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","RealMagicalGirl","DailyTask"]}]}

hannel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"d6","from":8,"to":9,"text":"抛开听起来离谱的反派魔法少女身份不谈，这副身体的模样绝妙，每个细节都满足自己曾经的幻想，让人想细细品尝。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl","Body","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d7","from":12,"to":14,"text":"美妙；自己太可爱了，无论面庞还是身材都与曾经想象的完美匹配；萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d8","from":15,"to":15,"text":"嘿嘿嘿，可爱的小狐狸。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d9","from":26,"to":26,"text":"“……喂？小破书你在吗？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuShu"]},{"id":"d10","from":29,"to":29,"text":"该不会所谓的反派魔法少女根本就不存在吧？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["VillainMagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d11","from":35,"to":35,"text":"“好疼！……鼻血！鼻血冒出来了啊啊啊啊！”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"d12","from":38,"to":38,"text":"【守护之星激活】","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MysteriousVoice","about":["GuardianStar"]},{"id":"d13","from":39,"to":39,"text":"【秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务】","channel":"voice","mode":"assertion","holder":"MysteriousVoice","about":["GuShu","DailyTask"]},{"id":"d14","from":40,"to":40,"text":"每日任务？守护之星？好家伙你来真的。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask","GuardianStar","MysteriousVoice"]},{"id":"d15","from":42,"to":42,"text":"这枚金色十字星材质不明、做工精致、手感扎实，不像塑料玩具，应该就是魔法少女们必备的变身道具。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["GuardianStar","MagicalGirl"]},{"id":"d16","from":43,"to":43,"text":"可这所谓的每日任务……要怎么查看呢？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["DailyTask"]},{"id":"d17","from":44,"to":44,"text":"像前世网络小说那样心里默念“系统！”，还是有什么特别的解锁密码？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["System"]},{"id":"d18","from":46,"to":46,"text":"比
